}}'''Tammuz''' is an [[Illuminator]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Tammuz}}

==Appearance==
Tammuz is a big man.

==Activities==
He was at the chapter house in [[Cairhien]] when [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Loial]] broke in and prematurely set off all of the fireworks.{{ref/book|2|27}} Later, he tracked [[Aludra]] to the stable of [[The Good Queen]] in [[Aringill]] to kill her for making and selling fireworks. There, with the help of [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]], Aludra overpowered him and four other men.{{ref/book|3|40}}
